name: Imran
first_negotiation_note:
On July 28, I contacted Mr. Imran through WhatsApp using the numbers provided to us by Nazir. Mr. Imran responded on the same day and said that he was interested in investing, with a budget of USD 150,000–230,000. He mentioned that he was looking for a property with a good ROI.

I recommended Sultan Haitham City, specifically the Wadi Zaha project, as a suitable option based on his requirements. I also created a WhatsApp group with Ahmed Al Haddabi, where we shared all the relevant project information with him.

I followed up with Mr. Imran on July 29, July 30, August 3, and August 10. During these follow-ups, I also informed him that we work with all major projects and could provide him with different investment options according to his requirements.

However, he only viewed my messages without responding.
